display_long_description:
"What if you could see the world through someone else's eyes?"

"Iromie: Color Vision & Aging Experience" is a Mixed Reality (MR) tool designed to bridge the gap in visual understanding. Using advanced Passthrough technology, it simulates in real-time how your current surroundings appear to individuals with different color vision types or age-related visual changes.

[Key Features]

Color Vision Simulation: Experience various types of color vision, including Protanopia, Deuteranopia, and Tritanopia.

Aging Vision Experience: Replicate the yellowing and clouding of the visual field associated with aging.

Intuitive Controls: Seamlessly cycle through filters using your VR controllers to compare visual differences instantly.

[Technology Credits] The visual simulation technology in this app is provided by The University of Electro-Communications (UEC) in Tokyo (Patent Pending). It delivers a highly accurate experience based on the latest academic research.

[Who is this for?]

Educators & Healthcare Professionals: Enhance empathy and awareness in accessibility training.

Designers & Architects: Validate universal design choices and color accessibility.

Public Organizations: Test the visibility of signage and safety routes.

Understanding the "difference" in vision is the first step towards true inclusivity. Gain a new perspective with Iromie.
